name: Thank you for being a regular
description: Once a year, every client with 3 or more visits gets a plain thank-you. No offer, no ask beyond an optional review line.
occasion: thank-you to a loyal regular client
guidelines: Thank them sincerely for being part of the CF Hair family. Reference their stylist and, lightly, the kind of service they usually come in for. Make it feel like a note from a person who knows them, not a loyalty programme. You may add one gentle line that a Google review helps a small neighbourhood salon.
